description: Symmetric-classification reviewer. GLM-5.2, no handed proposal: the reviewer independently answers A/B/C for the target column. Four isolated probes, fresh context each (structural independence). Same fixture and evidence-burden standard as 3B.1/3C; only the review framing changes (symmetric A/B/C vs a handed proposition). All four show the full (or masked) A1 pointed at the target column; only the target column differs.
contract: symmetric A/B/C, no handed proposal; evidence-burden standard ('absence of evidence that the target is a month is not evidence that it is not a month'; neither established -> C)
masking: Full = A1 rendered rows verbatim. Masked = full with one substitution: row 4 col 4 'Jakso A' -> '[TARGET]'. All other cells preserved.
